static_findings.snippet: 本 Skill 内置从学到装|装修课堂知识库,以下文件位于 `references/` 目录:

1. `ref-001.md` — 7 个去家务化设计手法(厨房单槽台下盆、全挂衣区、地板通铺、高脚家具、智能家电等)
2. `ref-002.md` — 卧室去家务化:充足且封闭收纳是刚需
3. `ref-003.md` — 门厅去家务化:封闭收纳 + 勤快,鞋柜镂空 / 800 库做法
4. `ref-004.md` — 客厅去家务化:满墙柜 + 勤快,收纳多才轻松
5. `ref-005.md` — 厨房去家务化:收纳是前提,高柜 / 封闭 / 开放厨房逻辑
6. `ref-006.md` — 10 条去家务化设计手法(新风 / 开放格 / 悬空 / 门 / 吊顶灯具 / 家具悬空 / 造型墙饰 / 电器 / 布艺 / 有水区域)
7. `ref-007.md` — 11 个去家务化设计陷阱(挡水下挂 / 浴室洗手池台下盆藏污应选一体盆 / 龙头 / 玻璃隔断 / 开放格 / 长条地漏 / 亮面材质 / 移门轨道 / 硬装造型等
- `ref-009.md` — 6 招家务开窍,再也不累了
- `ref-016.md` — 怎么装修,才能减少后期的家务活?
- `ref-020.md` — 家务偷懒秘籍!6 招让家十年如新
- `ref-022.md` — 10 个让家务变轻松的装修细节,不用弯腰才是好设计
- `ref-023.md` — 懒人装修的 15 个"偷懒神操作",家务少一半
- `ref-061.md` — 洗烘机衣帽间一体化·懒人设计 / 缩短家务动线
- `ref-079.md` — 入住三年总结:5 个让家越住越舒适的思路(减少家务量·懒人必备)
- `ref-018.md` — 卫生间越扫越脏?11 处装错,家务翻倍
- `ref-021.md` — 家务繁杂,餐边柜混乱?不勤快再多收纳也没用
- `ref-027.md` — 别再给未来挖坑!厨房这 9 处装错,家务活不断
- `ref-028.md` — 卫生间家务活不断?问题在这 11 处
- `ref-034.md` — 客餐厅想偷懒?先避开这 9 个"家务雷区"
- `ref-062.md` — 问答篇:含"去家务化设计,懒人装修必看"专章
- `ref-064.md` — 每日 10 问:含"减少家务量"7 个去家务化设计
- `ref-065.md` — 家里 7 个看着干净却最脏的地方(藏污纳垢 / 好打理)
- `ref-068.md` — 客餐厅不想天天打扫·9 个家务雷区
- `ref-081.md` — 厨房干净的真相:14 条易清洁细节 + 藏污纳垢翻车做法
- `ref-019.md` — 装修规划 7 个家政区,家务直接少一半
- `ref-033.md` — 告别家务混乱!7 个位置规划成"家政专区"
- `ref-089.md` — 家家必备家政收纳区,到底怎么做合适?(家政柜 / 家政间)
- 问具体空间(卧室 / 门厅 / 客厅 / 厨房)怎么做去家务化 → 读 `ref-002.md`~`ref-005.md`
- 问通用设计手法、怎么装才好打理 → 读 `ref-001.md`、`ref-006.md`
- 问避坑、哪些做法反而增加家务 → 读 `ref-007.md`
- `references/` 下全部 27 个文件均可按需读取,优先匹配用户问题主题

content.value_statement: Renovation choices can make everyday cleaning and storage more difficult. This guide uses a Chinese renovation knowledge base to suggest practical, room-specific alternatives.
actual_capabilities: Suggests storage and layout ideas for bedrooms, entryways, living rooms, and kitchens.
Explains design choices that can increase or reduce cleaning work.
Compares kitchen sink and bathroom basin recommendations by location.
Identifies common cleaning difficulties in bathrooms and kitchens.
Suggests places for utility storage and laundry equipment.
Draws on 27 bundled Chinese-language reference articles.
limitations: Recommendations are based on a fixed set of articles and may not reflect current products or local rules.
The guide cannot inspect a home or verify measurements and installation conditions.
Cleaning outcomes depend on household habits, materials, and maintenance.
Electrical, plumbing, ventilation, and structural changes require qualified local professionals.

use_cases.title: Plan a Kitchen
use_cases.description: Compare sink, cabinet, and surface choices for easier cleaning.

use_cases.title: Review a Room Layout
use_cases.description: Identify storage and cleaning tradeoffs in a proposed living room.

use_cases.title: Organize Utility Storage
use_cases.description: Explore locations for cleaning supplies and laundry equipment.

prompt_templates.title: Start with One Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest three easy-clean design ideas for my bedroom.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare easy-clean kitchen sink options for my budget and cooking habits: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Review a Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my living room plan for storage gaps and cleaning obstacles: [layout and household needs].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Renovation Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a room-by-room low-maintenance checklist for [home details]. Explain tradeoffs, priorities, and items requiring professional verification.

output_examples.input: How can I make my entryway easier to maintain?
output_examples.output: Consider closed shoe storage sized for the household. Leave accessible space for frequently worn shoes and confirm that doors and walkways remain clear.

output_examples.input: Should I use the same basin in the kitchen and bathroom?
output_examples.output: Treat the two spaces separately. The guide favors an undermount kitchen sink and an integrated bathroom basin, while emphasizing the cleaning of seams.

best_practices: Provide room dimensions, household size, habits, and budget.
Ask for tradeoffs and source references when comparing options.
Verify installation requirements with qualified local professionals.
anti_patterns: Treating reference recommendations as guaranteed cleaning results.
Applying kitchen sink advice to a bathroom without checking the context.
Ignoring access, ventilation, or appliance clearances to maximize storage.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It suggests renovation and storage choices intended to make homes easier to clean.

faq.question: Which rooms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers bedrooms, entryways, living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and utility storage areas.

faq.question: What sources does it use?
faq.answer: It uses 27 bundled Chinese-language renovation reference articles.

faq.question: Can it create a certified construction plan?
faq.answer: No. Have qualified local professionals check plans, codes, and installation details.

faq.question: Does it recommend the same sink for every room?
faq.answer: No. The guide distinguishes kitchen sinks from bathroom basins.

faq.question: Will these ideas eliminate housework?
faq.answer: No. Cleaning needs vary with household habits, materials, and maintenance.
